Name: JA - Mermaid Fence
Author: lindenmori
Description:
This mod adds a craftable pastel mermaid fence like the one in Animal Crossing: New Horizons. The gates look like the doors to the Mermaid dresser, and the double width gates look like a pink Shell arch, with the bottom slightly recolored to better match the fence, also from Animal Crossing.
Perfect for your beach farm!
The fence recipe can be purchased from Willy, and 10 stone, 1 clam and 1 coral make a stack of 10.
The fence has a durability of 150, so it should last a little longer than a stone fence.
Great complement to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1888]Tanilon's ACNL Mermaid set for CF[/url]!
Requires Json Assets.
